title: Effects of Irregular Sample Size and Gravity on Mechanical Response of Biological Tissue
content: Accurately obtaining the mechanical response of soft tissue has been a problem to be solved in the field of biomechanics. Mechanical response is related to many influencing factors. How to accurately quantify the influence of these factors is a way to solve this problem. In this research, the effect of sample dimensional parameters on mechanical response was quantitatively analyzed. The sample diameter, sample angle and gravity factor are defined as the key characteristic parameters. Based on the established finite element model of the compression process, the corresponding stress responses of each parameter were obtained in the form of numerical simulation. The stress difference percentage, high strain modulus and low strain modulus are defined to analyze the influence of parameter change on stress response. The results show that the three influencing factors have a nonnegligible impact on the mechanical response. Gravity will significantly increase the stress response, and the sample angle will reduce the stress response, and the effect and sample diameter are positively correlated. The analysis results of the influence of sample dimensional parameters can be as a foundation for quantitative study of the soft tissue mechanical response.
